info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v5-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API enables users to opt-out of receiving weather alerts tailored to their preferences. This operation removes existing subscriptions to weather notifications, providing a seamless way for users to manage their notification settings. Typical consumers include end-users who wish to reduce alert clutter or change their alert preferences. By utilizing this API, applications can enhance user experience by ensuring only relevant updates are delivered, thus respecting user choices.

delete.description: This operation allows a user to unsubscribe from receiving alerts. Calling this endpoint will remove the user from the alert notification list.

requestBody.description: The request body for unsubscribing from alerts, providing details necessary to execute the unsubscribe operation.
